title: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Requests for Submission of Materials, etc.)
(1) The leader of an evaluation team shall request the head of an emergency rescue support agency to submit materials relating to emergency rescue activities in accordance with the emergency rescue response plan under Article 54 of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). <Amended on July 9, 2026>
(2) Where necessary to evaluate emergency rescue activities, the team leader may request the head of an emergency rescue support agency, emergency rescue support personnel of such an agency, or other persons concerned to appear and state their opinions.
